Eligibility

You must be:

  • an international fee-paying student
  • starting year one of a full-time postgraduate taught master's degree programme (UK campus-based)
  • self-funded, and not in receipt of any other University award or sponsorship by an external organisation

How to apply

No scholarship application needed. This will be automatically awarded and will be deducted from your master's tuition fee.

Note

This scholarship replaces our previous regional postgraduate excellence awards.
